title: Sharing the Laundry Room
transcript:
This is a message for residents of Willow Court about the laundry room on the ground floor. From Thursday, both washing machines will use a booking board beside the door. The machines themselves are not being replaced. We are introducing the board because some residents have waited beside a machine for a long time, only to discover that another person intended to use it next.

Please write your flat number in an available time slot before bringing your washing downstairs. Each slot lasts one hour, which includes enough time to remove your clothes and wipe the machine. If you arrive more than ten minutes late, another resident may use the slot. This will prevent an empty machine from standing unused while people are waiting.

The drying rack by the window is for items that cannot go into a dryer. Please attach the small card provided and write the time you hung up your clothes. Items left for more than a day will be moved to a clean basket on the shelf, not thrown away. The shelf is away from the sink to keep everything dry.

Anyone who cannot easily reach the booking board should contact the building office. Staff can reserve a slot by telephone. We will try the arrangement for a month and then ask residents whether it has made sharing the room easier. Suggestions about the schedule are welcome, especially from people who work changing shifts.

questions.prompt: Why is the building introducing a booking board?
options: To organise access to the shared washing machines.
To choose a supplier for new machines.
To charge residents for using the drying rack.
To close the laundry room during the day.
questions.answer: To organise access to the shared washing machines.
questions.explanation: 原先有人等候很久才发现别人也打算使用机器，预约板用来协调使用次序。

questions.prompt: What happens if someone is over ten minutes late for a slot?
options: Their flat number is removed permanently.
Another resident may use the machine.
They must pay for two washing cycles.
The office will bring their washing downstairs.
questions.answer: Another resident may use the machine.
questions.explanation: 迟到超过十分钟后，其他住户可以使用该时段，避免机器空置。

questions.prompt: Where will clothes left on the rack for over a day be placed?
options: In a cupboard inside the building office.
On a bench outside the laundry room.
In a clean basket on a shelf.
In the machine that washed them.
questions.answer: In a clean basket on a shelf.
questions.explanation: 晾衣架上的衣物超过一天后会被移到架子上的干净篮子，不会被丢弃。

questions.prompt: How can residents book if they cannot reach the board easily?
options: By leaving clothes outside the door.
By asking the cleaner to move the board.
By writing their names on the drying rack.
questions.explanation: 无法方便地够到预约板的住户可联系物业办公室，由工作人员电话代约。
